script.title: Imperial I-class — Devastator
script.description: A 144-stud Imperial Star Destroyer with a razor-edged layered hull, recessed machinery trenches, eight heavy turbolaser batteries, terraced command citadel, twin shield generators and seven illuminated aft exhausts. Two compact black cradles support the ship above its recessed ventral docking bay.
